nodes.title: ca-demo-uat (ca-demo-uat.example.io): Probing. This page asks it once a minute while it shows this diagram, and not while it is paused or hidden; nothing asks it from here while no page is open, so it can scale to zero. An app that scaled to zero starts on the first request: the page waits up to 90 seconds for its first answer before it says Not responding.
